ordering: alphabetical_by_canonical_name (fixed; index == training class id; matches ocular.config.CLASSES)

classes.name: Choroidal Neovascularization
classes.description: Neovascular membrane with subretinal/intraretinal fluid; wet AMD spectrum.

classes.name: Diabetic Macular Edema
classes.description: Retinal thickening with intraretinal cystoid spaces / hard exudates in a diabetic context.

classes.name: Drusen
classes.description: Discrete sub-RPE deposits; early/intermediate AMD risk marker without CNV or GA.

classes.name: Normal
classes.description: No pathological OCT findings; preserved foveal contour and retinal layer architecture.

notes: `group` is consumed by the CDS rule layer (configs/cds/rules_v1.yaml) for urgency mapping, not by the classifier.
Key order and ids match ocular.config.CLASSES = ['CNV','DME','DRUSEN','NORMAL'] (Kermany OCT2017).
Class ids are frozen. If classes change, bump the `dataset` tag and retrain — do not silently reorder.
